title: OCSMP Server Pack
description: Resource pack used on the OCSMP server
body:
OCSMP Extras is a resource pack designed for use on the [OCSMP](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ocsmp) Server. The pack allows many server features to function, such as custom paintings and many other tweaks. This pack is already installed on the server, so you don't need to install it to play with it on the server!

For more, see [OCSMP Extras](https://modrinth.com/project/moar-ocsmp-n-stuff)

Requires Optifine/alternatives.
